title: Hostinger coupon: you don't need one — what the referral link gives
seoTitle: Hostinger Coupon 2026: 20% on the First Period, No Code Needed
description: Does Hostinger have a coupon? You don't need one. The referral link already gives 20% on the first period of a new plan. See what changes at renewal.
metaDescription: There is no code to type at Hostinger: the referral link gives 20% on the first period, does not stack with other coupons, and renewal goes back to the standard price.
imageAlt: -20% text next to two chain links, in white on a purple background

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: You don't need a coupon. Hostinger's referral offer has no code to type: the discount is already in the link. Through the link, a new plan comes with **20% only on the first period**. After that, renewal goes back to the **standard price**, and the discount **does not stack with other coupons**.

contentSections.heading: What Hostinger says about coupons
paragraphs: In its Black Friday FAQ, Hostinger states that no coupon code is needed for the main offers, because the discounts are applied automatically. The same FAQ warns that some promotions for specific channels may use separate codes. This text covers only the referral link. We don't cite codes from other sites, and to get this link's discount you don't need any.

contentSections.heading: Where the code goes
paragraphs: It is already in the link, so you don't type anything. The link takes you to Hostinger's pricing page, where you can open the plans and compare the first-period total with and without the link. For a summary of the offer on this site, see the [Hostinger page here on the site](/en/coupons/hostinger).

contentSections.heading: The site runs on Hostinger
paragraphs: This site runs on Hostinger, and Bruno has been a customer since 2024, for more than 24 months. He uses Business web hosting, a KVM 2 VPS, Business email and domains, all with automatic renewal. Every time there was a problem, support solved it, mainly through the AI agent. He personally has never seen the service go down. This is his experience; the discount rules are on Hostinger's page, and they are what this text describes.

contentSections.heading: What it costs with and without the link
paragraphs: Prices depend on your region and on the campaign running at the time, so we don't list them here. To see the price in your region, check Hostinger's pricing page through the link: the 20% applies to the first period, and renewal is shown on each plan card.
postParagraphs: Renewal has no discount: it goes to the standard price, shown below each plan's card.
For the campaign itself, with the dates and the comparison with buying without the link, see the [Hostinger Black Friday guide](/en/reviews/hostinger-black-friday).

contentSections.heading: How the discount works
paragraphs: The page says the 20% covers the first period of a new plan, whatever the product chosen. The programme terms, however, limit the eligible services and refer to subscriptions of 12 months or more. That is why this text does not promise the discount on every plan: check in the cart whether the 20% appears on the plan you chose. The terms also say “up to 20%” for people who arrive through the link; the page shows 20%.

contentSections.heading: Renewal: what changes after the first period
paragraphs: After the first period, the plan renews at the standard price, shown below each plan's card. The page says you can change the billing period or cancel at any time before renewal. To turn off automatic renewal and find out what to do about a charge you don't recognize, see the [Hostinger article on Trustpilot](/en/reviews/hostinger-trustpilot-reviews).

contentSections.heading: Why the discount doesn't stack with another coupon
paragraphs: The page's FAQ says this is already the best price it can offer through this link, which is why other discount coupons do not stack with it. If you find a code on another site, it does not stack with the link, and we don't recommend any.

contentSections.heading: VPS, email and domain
paragraphs: The programme terms list website hosting, VPS and Hostinger email among the eligible services. Domains are not on that list, so we don't count on the 20% for a domain; what counts is what appears in the cart. The page also doesn't use the term “first purchase”: its rule is the first period of a new plan.

contentSections.heading: Existing customers
paragraphs: The link does not apply to renewals or to purchases already made. The terms describe the programme as aimed at new users. The page does not say what Hostinger offers existing customers, so this text does not promise a renewal discount. If you already have a plan, check the renewal price in your Hostinger control panel.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
bullets: Open the link using this article's button.
Compare the first-period total of the plan with and without the link.
In the cart, check that the 20% appears on the first period and that renewal is listed. The page does not say whether the account must be new, so this is the moment to check.
If the cart price differs from what you see elsewhere, the cart price is the one that counts. Prices can change.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: **Does Hostinger have a coupon?** No need. The 20% discount is already in the referral link, on the first period of a new plan.
**Does the referral link discount renewal?** No. Renewal goes back to the standard price, shown below each plan's card.
**Does the discount stack with another coupon?** No. The page says other discount coupons do not stack with the link.
**Does a domain qualify for the discount?** The terms don't list domains among the eligible services. Check the cart before paying.
**Do existing customers get the discount?** The page's rule excludes renewals and purchases already made. To renew, check the price in your Hostinger control panel.

contentSections.heading: Transparency note
paragraphs: This is a referral article. Purchases made through the link may earn Hostinger credit for Bruno, at no extra cost to the buyer. This site runs on Hostinger, and Bruno has been a customer since 2024. Prices and campaigns change, and Hostinger can change them at any time.
